name: Krea3 Publisher for PanneauPocket
author: Krea3

sections.description:
Krea3 Publisher for PanneauPocket allows WordPress editors to send selected posts to PanneauPocket through Krea3 Hub.

The plugin adds controls to posts for selecting the message type, visibility period, and attachments.

Paid service required

This plugin is a client for the Krea3 Hub SaaS service. The plugin can be installed at no charge, but publishing to PanneauPocket and retrieving the widget require an active Krea3 subscription and Hub credentials supplied by Krea3.

Commercial information, pricing, demo requests, and service activation are available at https://hub.krea3.fr.

No PanneauPocket publication can be transmitted without valid Hub credentials. Access is checked and can be revoked by Krea3 Hub.

Features

  • Enable publishing separately for each post
  • Information and Alert message types
  • Start and expiration dates
  • Up to five attachments, with the featured image available as a fallback
  • Krea3 Hub connection test
  • PanneauPocket shortcode and widget for activated accounts

Independence

This plugin is provided by Krea3. It is not developed, affiliated with, or endorsed by PanneauPocket. PanneauPocket is a trademark of its respective owner.

External services

This plugin connects to external services that are required for its main features.

Krea3 Hub

Service: Krea3 Hub — https://hub.krea3.fr
Endpoint: https://hub.krea3.fr/wp-json/krea3-api/v1/relay/
Purpose: validate access, transmit selected publications, and retrieve the PanneauPocket widget URL.
Data sent: the client slug, Krea3 Hub access key, and secret key; depending on the requested action, the post ID, title, content, message type, dates, and attachment URLs.
When data is sent: during a connection test, when saving a post with PanneauPocket publishing enabled, and when loading the widget after its cache has expired.
Transport: requests use HTTPS. The plugin sends no telemetry and does not contact the Hub until a service feature is used.
Commercial information, demos, and activation: https://hub.krea3.fr
Krea3 legal notice and privacy policy: https://www.krea3.fr/mentions-legales/ and https://www.krea3.fr/politique-de-confidentialite/

PanneauPocket

When the widget or public link is displayed, the visitor’s browser may load a page or resource provided by PanneauPocket. This request sends the technical information normally included in a web request, such as the IP address and user agent.

Application: https://app.panneaupocket.com/
Privacy policy: https://www.panneaupocket.com/mentions-legales-et-politiques-confidentialite/
Terms of use: https://www.panneaupocket.com/cgu/

Source code and build

The plugin uses the jQuery UI library supplied by WordPress and includes a jQuery UI stylesheet. Project source and documentation are available at https://jqueryui.com/ and are distributed under the MIT license.

The plugin’s own JavaScript is included in human-readable form and requires no build step.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect visitor data on behalf of Krea3. Post data is sent only when PanneauPocket publishing is enabled by an authorized user.

The site owner remains responsible for transmitted content and must ensure there is a legal basis for publishing any personal data included in posts or attachments.

Trademarks

PanneauPocket is a trademark of its respective owner. The name is used only to identify connector compatibility.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the krea3-publisher-for-panneaupocket directory to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP archive from the WordPress administration screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Request service activation at https://hub.krea3.fr.
  4. Open PanneauPocket > Settings, then enter the client slug, API key, and secret key supplied by Krea3.
  5. Save the settings and test the connection.
  6. In a post, enable Publish to PanneauPocket only when the information should be transmitted, then publish or update the post.
sections.faq:
Do I need a subscription?

Yes. Publishing and the widget rely on the external Krea3 Hub service. Active credentials supplied after subscribing are required.

Can I publish without Krea3 Hub credentials?

No. The Hub authenticates every request. Calls without credentials or with invalid credentials are rejected.

What data is sent?

Only the technical credentials required by the Hub and the data from the post selected for publishing: title, content, dates, type, ID, and optional attachments.

Does the plugin track visitors?

No. The plugin contains no telemetry or advertising. Displaying a PanneauPocket widget may, however, cause the visitor’s browser to make a direct request to PanneauPocket, as described in the External services section.

What happens when my access expires?

Krea3 Hub rejects new requests. The widget uses a short cache so that revoked access is taken into account quickly.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Added contextual and quick help to the PanneauPocket administration screens.
  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
  • Completed the migration to Krea3 Hub and made the relay address read-only.
  • Strengthened access checks, data validation, and the connection test.
  • The widget now requires active Krea3 Hub access and uses a short cache.
  • Improved escaping, direct-file protection, and WordPress.org compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial public version with PanneauPocket message publishing, dates, message types, and attachment management.
